presetLibraryHelp: Save your design on this server and reuse it in any scene. Presets are shared with all signed-in users.
presetSaved: Preset saved. It is now available in the scene editor.
presetDeleted: Preset deleted. Existing scene layers are kept.
presetDeleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Existing scene layers will be kept.
presetInvalid: Enter a name (up to 80 bytes) and valid component settings.
presetConflict: This preset changed in another window. Reload the list before updating it.
presetUnavailable: The preset library is unavailable. Try reloading it.
presetSceneHelp: Save designs under Scene Components, then insert them here. Each layer gets its own copy of the preset settings.
presetBlank: Or add a component with default settings
authChangeConsole: Change this password after signing in.
authInitialHelp: First start: use admin and the temporary password shown in the DeckStatus console.
authChangeHelp: Choose a new password with at least 12 characters. The temporary password must be changed before using the app. Afterwards, sign in again.
authPasswordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
authPasswordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
authUsernameInvalid: Use 3–40 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
authPasswordLength: Use a password with 12–256 UTF-8 bytes.
authUsernameTaken: This username is already in use.
authDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
adminIntro: Manage users, review persistent track ratings and control shared overlay links.
adminRatingHelp: Ratings stay with each track across restarts and sessions. Expand your audience through the public Full History link.
adminPasswordHelp: New users must change their password at first login. Leave this field empty when editing to keep the password. A reset signs the user out.
adminDeleteConfirm: Delete this user and revoke their sessions?
adminLinksHelp: Regenerating keys invalidates all existing standalone deck, master and waveform URLs. Generate new URLs in overlay settings. Scene links are managed separately in the scene editor.
adminRotateConfirm: Invalidate every standalone overlay link? Existing OBS sources will need new URLs.
adminRotated: Keys regenerated. Copy new links from overlay settings.
portalRateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait one minute.
portalSaveFailed: Could not save data. Check available space and folder permissions.
portalDataInvalid: Stored data is invalid. Restore a backup; the existing file was kept.
portalCapacity: The storage or item limit has been reached.
portalBootstrapFailed: The initial password could not be unlocked by this Windows account.
portalInUse: Another DeckStatus instance is using this data directory.
ratingThanks: Thanks! Your rating has been saved.
ratingHelp: Rate tracks without signing in. One rating per browser and track; click another star to change it. Ratings persist across sessions. Clearing cookies or using another browser allows another vote.
ratingUnknown: Open this track in the history before rating it.
ratingVisitHistory: Reload the history and allow cookies to rate tracks.
sceneIntro: Arrange your overlays on a full-size canvas. Save to update the same OBS source live.
sceneCanvas: Scene canvas; select a layer and use arrow keys to move it
sceneCanvasHelp: Drag to move; drag the corner to resize. Arrow keys move one pixel, Shift moves ten. Changes appear in OBS after saving.
sceneObsSize: Set this width and height in OBS
sceneOptionsHelp: Adjust this layer independently of its saved preset. Source width controls the layout; the layer size scales the result.
sceneDeleteConfirm: Delete this scene? Its OBS link will stop working.
sceneRotateConfirm: Invalidate this scene's current OBS link?
sceneSaveFirst: Save your changes before regenerating the link.
sceneInvalid: Invalid scene. Check dimensions, name and overlay values.
sceneConflict: This scene changed in another editor. Reload the saved scene before editing again.
networkIntro: Share the dashboard, API and overlays with OBS or a browser on your network. The initial default is this PC only.
networkDomainHelp: Enter a domain such as ds.spartokos.net, without https://, a port or a path. Your reverse proxy provides HTTPS on port 443 and forwards to DeckStatus with the original Host and Origin headers. Leave empty to disable domain access.
networkRemoteControlHelp: Signed-in users on other PCs may start, switch or stop audio and discover, connect or disconnect ProLink devices. Scene editing and account permissions are managed separately.
networkSaveHelp: Saved in DeckStatus.network.json beside the EXE, unless --network-config selects another file. Restart DeckStatus to apply changes; this also begins a new track-history session.
networkRestart: Saved settings differ from the running server. Restart DeckStatus to apply them.
networkOverrides: Command-line options override saved settings for this launch. Remove those options on the next launch to use the saved values.
networkAddressHelp: Open the interface using a LAN address or your HTTPS domain. Copied OBS links always use 127.0.0.1 for OBS on the DeckStatus PC. For OBS elsewhere, replace that origin with a reachable server address.
networkNoLan: No LAN address is active. Enable network access and restart DeckStatus to connect another PC.
networkSavedRestart: Saved. Restart DeckStatus to apply the new settings.
networkConnectHelp: Connect both PCs to the same network. Allow DeckStatus.exe through Windows Firewall on your private network for the chosen TCP port. Then open a listed LAN address on the OBS PC.
networkScopeHelp: Direct HTTP access and the connection from your proxy to DeckStatus need a trusted network. Your proxy handles public HTTPS. Administration requires sign-in; Full History is public and OBS links grant read access. Network settings can only be changed locally using an IP or localhost address.
networkReadOnly: Read-only network access. Change audio sources and ProLink connections on the DeckStatus PC, or enable remote controls in its network settings.
networkLocalOnly: Change network settings on the DeckStatus PC using its IP or localhost address. This page is read-only from other PCs and through the public domain.
networkUnavailable: Network settings are unavailable. Check the DeckStatus connection.
networkInvalidSettings: Choose a valid IPv4 listen address and an integer port from 1 to 65535.
networkInvalidDomain: Enter a DNS name such as ds.spartokos.net without a scheme, port, path or wildcard. Use punycode for international names, or leave empty to disable domain access.
networkInvalidFile: The network configuration file is invalid or unreadable. Correct or rename DeckStatus.network.json (or the file selected by --network-config) and restart.
networkSaveFailed: Could not save network settings. Check write access to the configuration folder.
cliNetworkHelp:
NETWORK (both modes):
  --bind 127.0.0.1       This PC only (initial default)
  --bind 0.0.0.0         All IPv4 network interfaces
  --bind 192.168.1.20    One local IPv4 interface
  --allow-remote-control Allow LAN audio/ProLink control
  --network-config PATH Use another network settings file
  --data-dir PATH       Users, ratings and scenes (default: DeckStatus.data)
Configure: /network/settings. Saved network changes apply after restart.
Sign in at /login; initial admin credentials are shown in this console.
modeUnavailable: Unavailable in the current mode. Restart DeckStatus in the required mode.
prolinkIntro: Discover CDJ-3000, CDJ-3000X and XDJ-AZ players, plus DJM-A9 and DJM-900NXS2 mixers, on PRO DJ LINK.
prolinkModeRequired: Start DeckStatus.exe --mode prolink (or Start-ProLink.cmd) to use this page. Rekordbox remains the default mode.
prolinkSelectHelp: Select up to four player endpoints. Selected player numbers, in ascending order, map to Decks 1–4. An XDJ-AZ can announce multiple players at one IP address. Disconnect before changing the selection.
prolinkNoDevices: No devices discovered. Connect the PC and your players to the same Ethernet network, then choose Find devices.
prolinkNetworkHelp: Discovery only listens for announcements. Connecting joins the network and requests track metadata. Allow the bundled Java runtime through Windows Firewall on your private DJ network. Rekordbox and other Link apps may already occupy the required ports.
prolinkAvailableHelp: The same dashboard, deck/master overlays, timelines and Full History. Playback, Sync and On-Air indicators are shown here when available. The audio waveform still uses your chosen Windows audio input.
prolinkLimitsHelp: Experimental hardware integration; no physical model or firmware combination has been validated. Mixer faders, EQ, FX and analysed track waveforms are unavailable. No playback, loading, sync or tempo-control commands are sent.
prolinkMetadataHelp: Metadata and artwork are requested directly from the device (DBServer). The legacy export.pdb fallback is disabled to avoid incorrect OneLibrary/Device Library Plus track IDs. Missing metadata stays unknown; streaming and cloud tracks are unverified.
prolinkOnAirHelp: On-Air is a mixer channel indication, not proof of audible music. Match player numbers to mixer channels. Master overlay and history continue to follow the tempo MASTER; a mixer master or an unselected player has no current track card.
prolinkMixerAutomatic: Mixer · detected automatically with the selected players
prolinkUnsupportedDevice: This device is not supported by this release.
prolinkReadFailed: Cannot read ProLink status. Check that DeckStatus is running.
prolinkConnecting: Joining the PRO DJ LINK network…
prolinkWaitingStatus: Waiting for fresh player data. Check the network and selected devices.
prolinkRuntimeMissing: ProLink runtime missing. Extract the complete release ZIP, including the prolink folder.
prolinkHelperFailed: Could not start or communicate with the ProLink helper. Check the release files.
prolinkHelperStopped: The ProLink helper stopped. Find devices to restart it.
prolinkHelperStale: The ProLink helper is not responding. Restart DeckStatus.
prolinkInvalidData: The ProLink helper returned invalid data.
prolinkInvalidCommand: Invalid ProLink action or player selection.
prolinkUnsupportedNetwork: An unsupported device is present. Supported models: CDJ-3000, CDJ-3000X, XDJ-AZ, DJM-A9 and DJM-900NXS2.
prolinkAmbiguousNetwork: Multiple or unreachable DJ network interfaces detected. Use one adapter on the same network as all devices.
prolinkPortsBusy: PRO DJ LINK ports are already in use. Close Rekordbox or other Link software on this PC and try again.
prolinkConnectionFailed: Could not connect. Check device selection, unique player numbers, Ethernet, firewall and other Link apps, then stop discovery and retry.
prolinkStartup: ProLink mode. Open /prolink/settings to discover and connect devices.
rekordboxSetupIntro: The original DeckStatus source: read-only deck data from your running Rekordbox instance.
rekordboxModeRequired: This connection is available in Rekordbox mode. Start DeckStatus.exe without --mode prolink.
rekordboxSetupHelp: Tested only with the author's Rekordbox 7.2.18.0 build. Startup, process selection (--pid), database selection (--database) and the injection profile remain unchanged. Restart DeckStatus to change those options.
Mode must be rekordbox or prolink.
ProLink mode cannot be combined with --d: ProLink mode cannot be combined with --demo, --pid or --database.
masterTitle: One track leads. Your history follows.
masterIntro: Follow the current master automatically and style your stream.
deckIntro: Configure each deck here. Every deck gets its own overlay URL.
historyHelp: 0 shows only the master. Up to 50 previous tracks appear in this overlay; Full History keeps the complete session.
scaleHelp: Scale cover, text and card together. The current master stays at 1.00×.
alignHelp: Align the cards and the overlay inside the browser source.
title: Title
bpmHelp: BPM shows current and original tempo. History uses the last captured tempo.
timelineHelp: Elapsed time and duration from Rekordbox. In the master overlay, only on the current track. Display only.
durationHelp: Fade and resize smoothly. 0 ms disables animation.
presetHelp: A preset replaces colours, opacity and the frame.
previewHint: Checkerboard means transparency. No loaded track means no current card. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
obsHelp: Add a browser source with this URL. Replace the URL in OBS after changing settings.
copied: URL copied. Paste it into your OBS browser source.
copyFallback: URL selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy.
minField: Select at least one track field.
allDecksHelp: Copy this design to all four decks. Their individual URLs update below.
appliedAll: Design saved for all four decks.
invalidDeck: Invalid deck. Choose deck=1 through deck=4.
unreachable: DeckStatus unavailable. Is the program running?
liveIntro: Track metadata, tempo and key in one place.
demoNotice: Demo mode: these are sample tracks. There is no connection to Rekordbox.
label: Label
dashboardHint: Updated every 500 ms. A loaded deck does not prove audible playback. Configure an overlay for your OBS browser source.
cliHelp:
DeckStatus (Windows x64)
  DeckStatus.exe [--pid PID] [--port 18740] [--database PATH] [--lang en|de]
  DeckStatus.exe --demo [--port 18740] [--lang en|de]

Start Rekordbox first. Stop with Ctrl+C.
Dashboard: http://127.0.0.1:18740/
JSON: /api/state   Deck settings: /overlay/settings
Master settings: /master-overlay/settings

PRO DJ LINK:
  DeckStatus.exe --mode prolink [--port 18740] [--lang en|de]
  /prolink/settings
Numerische Option ausserhalb des gueltig: Numeric option is outside the allowed range.
Seit mehr als 3 Sekunden keine Deckdaten: No deck data received for more than 3 seconds.
Demo-Modus: keine Verbindung zu Rekordbo: Demo mode: not connected to Rekordbox.
Rekordbox sqlite3.dll besitzt nicht alle: Rekordbox sqlite3.dll is missing required functions
Rekordbox-Datenbank konnte nicht lesend: Could not open the Rekordbox database read-only
SQLCipher oder Rekordbox zlib.dll nicht: SQLCipher or Rekordbox zlib.dll is unavailable
Rekordbox-Datenbank konnte nicht entsper: Could not unlock the Rekordbox database
Rekordbox-Datenbank inkompatibel oder mo: Rekordbox database incompatible or currently locked

Mehrere Rekordbox-Prozesse gefunden. Bit: Multiple Rekordbox processes found. Select one with --pid <PID>.
Rekordbox-Modulliste ist noch nicht stab: Rekordbox module list is not stable yet; try again.

Injection-Zugriff verweigert; Rekordbox: Injection access denied; run Rekordbox and the bridge with the same user permissions
DLL-Pfad konnte im Zielprozess nicht res: Cannot allocate the DLL path in the target process

Rekordbox 7.2.18 code guards do not matc: Rekordbox 7.2.18 code guards do not match; this executable is unsupported.
This bridge supports the documented reko: This bridge supports the documented rekordbox.exe 7.2.18.0 x64 build only.
Could not reserve the HTTP socket exclus: Could not reserve the HTTP socket exclusively.
waveIntro: Choose an audio source, find your look and bring it to your stream.
waveInputHelp: Select a Windows microphone, line-in or interface. Output loopback captures the shared Windows mix of a playback device; it is not tied to Rekordbox MASTER. ASIO/exclusive output may not appear in loopback.
waveShared: One source is shared by all waveform overlays. Capture starts only when you press Start and ends on Stop or app exit. Audio is analysed locally; no recordings are saved. Microphones may require Windows microphone privacy permission.
wavePreviewHelp: The checkerboard indicates transparency. Start capture and play audio on the selected source to see the waveform. Presets change the design without changing the source.
waveObsHelp: Add a browser source using this URL and the dimensions below. Keep DeckStatus running and capture started. Source selection is shared; this URL stores only the design. The waveform does not play sound.
waveWaiting: Capture active · waiting for audio packets
waveNoDevices: No active audio devices found. Connect a device and refresh.
audioPermission: Audio access denied. Check Windows microphone privacy settings.
audioDeviceLost: Audio device unavailable. Refresh devices and select a source again.
audioFormat: This device audio format is not supported.
audioError: Could not open the audio stream. Check the device and try again.
waveCopyManual: Press Ctrl+C to copy the selected URL.
historyIntro: Follow the set and rate the tracks you love.
historyEmpty: No tracks yet. History starts when DeckStatus observes a loaded MASTER deck.
historySessionHelp: This tracklist starts fresh when DeckStatus restarts. Your ratings stay saved.
historyOlderPage: Earlier entries · use Latest tracks to return to live updates.
prolinkAzHelp: On XDJ-AZ, select PRO DJ LINK → Connect to CDJ/XDJ/DJM. Only announced player endpoints can be selected. Standalone four-deck mode and its USB 2 metadata are not supported. Metadata and timeline availability depend on the device reports.
prolink3000xHelp: Experimental CDJ-3000X support with direct metadata requests for OneLibrary media. A free player number from 1–4 is preferred for metadata queries; if none is available, metadata may be unavailable. Cloud and streaming sources are unverified.
prolinkMixerHelp: Detected automatically for mixer status and On-Air availability. Match player numbers to mixer channels. Fader, EQ and FX values are not exposed.
